description:
# Mobile Responsive Polish

Audit and improve the game UI on small mobile screens (iPhone SE, older Androids, budget tablets). Ensure the keyboard, game grid, and navigation all fit without scrolling. Optimize touch targets and font sizes for mobile play.

## Rationale
React-wordle (the most popular open-source Wordle clone) has documented mobile responsiveness issues on small screens — iPhone SE and similar devices require scrolling. Since families and students primarily play on phones and tablets, a polished mobile experience is essential for adoption. This is a high-impact, relatively low-effort improvement.

## User Stories
- As a student using a school Chromebook, I want the game to fit my screen so that I can play without scrolling
- As a parent playing on my phone, I want the keyboard buttons to be easy to tap so that I don't mispress letters
- As a player with an older Android phone, I want the game to work on my smaller screen without broken layout

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Game grid and virtual keyboard fit on screen without scrolling on 320px-width devices
- [ ] Touch targets meet minimum 44x44px accessibility guideline
- [ ] Font sizes are readable on small screens without zooming
- [ ] Navigation between pages (home, daily, create, leaderboard) is thumb-friendly
- [ ] Landscape orientation is handled gracefully (game remains playable)
- [ ] Tested on iPhone SE (375px), Galaxy A-series (360px), and standard tablet (768px) viewports
- [ ] No horizontal overflow or content clipping on any tested viewport
workflow_rationale: Single-service UI polish task focused on CSS adjustments for mobile responsiveness. No backend changes, no complex dependencies. Simple implementation with clear acceptance criteria and existing test framework.

phases.name: Mobile Responsive Implementation
phases.description: Audit current mobile layout, add responsive CSS for small screens, optimize touch targets and fonts

subtasks.description: Audit current mobile layout on 320px, 360px, 375px viewports and document issues

verification.instructions: Review mobile-audit.md for documented layout issues on small viewports (320px, 360px, 375px). Should identify: elements that overflow, touch targets below 44px, font sizes that require zooming, navigation issues.

subtasks.description: Add CSS media queries for small screens (320px-375px range)

verification.expected: New media queries present for small screen breakpoints

subtasks.notes: Add responsive rules for .board, .keyboard, .panel, .topbar at 320px, 360px, and 375px breakpoints. Use existing @media (max-width: 720px) pattern as reference.

subtasks.description: Optimize game board (.board, .tile) sizing for small screens without scrolling

checks: Game board fits entirely within 320px viewport
Tiles remain square (aspect-ratio maintained)
Gap between tiles proportionally reduced on small screens
No horizontal scrolling required

subtasks.notes: Adjust .board width calculation, .tile max-width, and gap spacing for 320px+ screens. Tiles should scale down while maintaining readability and aspect ratio.

subtasks.description: Ensure keyboard touch targets meet 44x44px minimum accessibility guideline

checks: All .key elements are at least 44px tall on 320px viewport
All .key elements are at least 44px wide on 320px viewport
Keys remain readable and tappable
ENTER and BACK keys (wide keys) maintain appropriate sizing

subtasks.notes: Current .key has min-height: clamp(2.4rem, 7vw, 3.2rem). May need adjustment for 320px screens. Ensure padding and font-size work together to meet 44x44px minimum.

subtasks.description: Optimize font sizes for readability on small screens without zooming

checks: Tile font size (1.6rem) readable on 320px screen
Key font size (0.9rem) readable without zoom
Body text and labels remain readable
h1, h2, h3 headings scale appropriately

subtasks.notes: May need to reduce .tile font-size from 1.6rem on very small screens. Check all text elements for readability. Consider using clamp() for fluid typography.

subtasks.description: Make navigation buttons (.admin-link, .ghost, .link-button) thumb-friendly on mobile

checks: Top navigation links meet 44x44px touch target minimum
Footer buttons (.link-button) are easy to tap
Spacing between navigation elements prevents mis-taps
All interactive elements have adequate padding

subtasks.notes: Review .admin-link, .ghost, .link-button classes. Ensure padding creates touch targets of at least 44x44px on mobile viewports.

subtasks.description: Add landscape orientation support with CSS to keep game playable

checks: Game remains playable in landscape on 568x320 (iPhone SE landscape)
Board and keyboard both visible without excessive scrolling
Layout adjusts gracefully to landscape aspect ratio
No layout breaks or overlapping elements

subtasks.notes: Add @media (orientation: landscape) rules to reduce vertical spacing and ensure board + keyboard fit in viewport height. May need to reduce .panel padding, .board gap, and .keyboard spacing.

subtasks.description: Reduce panel padding and spacing for small screens to maximize content area

checks: Panel padding reduced on small screens to maximize space
Topbar padding reduced while maintaining visual hierarchy
Whitespace balanced - not cramped, not wasteful
All content remains accessible and readable

subtasks.notes: Current .panel has padding: 2rem. Current .topbar has padding: 2rem clamp(...). Reduce these on 320px-375px screens to create more room for game board and keyboard.

phases.name: Mobile Testing and Verification
phases.description: Update Playwright tests to cover small viewports and verify all acceptance criteria

subtasks.description: Add Playwright tests for iPhone SE (375px), Galaxy A (360px), and minimum (320px) viewports

verification.expected: All mobile viewport tests pass including new 320px, 360px, 375px tests

subtasks.notes: Extend existing viewports array to include {name: 'iphone-se', width: 375, height: 667}, {name: 'galaxy-a', width: 360, height: 740}, {name: 'min-width', width: 320, height: 568}

subtasks.description: Add touch target verification test to ensure 44x44px minimum for all interactive elements

verification.expected: Touch target test passes, verifying all .key, .admin-link, .link-button elements meet 44x44px minimum

subtasks.notes: Create new test that measures boundingBox of all interactive elements (.key, buttons, links) and asserts height >= 44 && width >= 44

subtasks.description: Add landscape orientation test to verify game remains playable

verification.expected: Landscape orientation test passes for 568x320 viewport (iPhone SE landscape)

subtasks.notes: Test landscape mode with setViewportSize({ width: 568, height: 320 }). Verify board and keyboard both visible and no horizontal overflow.

subtasks.description: Verify no horizontal overflow or content clipping on all tested viewports

verification.expected: Overflow test passes for all viewports (320px, 360px, 375px, 390px, 412px)

subtasks.notes: Add test that evaluates document.body.scrollWidth and compares to viewport width. Also check for elements with .boundingBox().x + .boundingBox().width > viewport.width

phases.name: Final Validation and Acceptance
phases.description: Run full test suite and perform manual verification of all acceptance criteria

subtasks.description: Run full test suite to ensure no regressions

verification.expected: All tests pass (lint, schema validation, unit tests, and UI tests)

subtasks.notes: npm run check runs: eslint, schema validation, nit guardrails, and jest tests. This ensures no regressions in existing functionality.

subtasks.description: Manual verification of all acceptance criteria across target viewports

verification.instructions: Review acceptance-verification.md which documents manual testing results for: (1) 320px width fit without scrolling, (2) 44x44px touch targets, (3) readable fonts without zoom, (4) thumb-friendly navigation, (5) landscape playability, (6) all target viewports tested, (7) no overflow/clipping

subtasks.notes: Create a checklist document verifying each acceptance criterion from spec.md. Include screenshots or detailed observations for each viewport size.
